current timeline code is an absolute mess. This should fix that.

**New Structure (subject to change)**
Abstract Classes:
TimelineComponent (Contain wherever Score/ScoreView/CellDimensions/Font are needed)
TimelineLabel (Handles generic label code, not pixmaps)
These abstract classes are inherited among the following regular classes.

Regular Classes:
Timeline _(QDockWidget that contains a QSplitter)_
-- TimelineMeta _(QSplitter)_
---- TimelineMetaLabels _(QGraphicsView)_
------ TimelineMetaLabel _(QGraphicsItemGroup)_
---- TimelineMetaRows _(QGraphicsView)_
------ TimelineMetaRowsValue _(QGraphicsItemGroup)_
-- TimelineData _(QSplitter)_
---- TimelineDataLabels _(QGraphicsView)_
------ TimelineDataLabel _(QGraphicsItemGroup)_
---- TimelineDataGrid _(QGraphicsView)_
------ TimelineDataGridCell _(QGraphicsRectItem)_

**Improvements (subject to change)**

1. Reduce the number of timeline updates. Originally, it updated every time the mouse was dragged. Now the timeline, selection, and view only update when their respective parts change.
2. Graphical bugs such as: the selection wouldn't clear if you cleared via the score; selecting certain cells would not update the score correctly, leaving artifacts.
3. Bug fixes: #280005, #276002 (WIP)
4. By using higher precision and better arithmetic, the timeline should look cleaner.
5.
